default.lyrics:
VERSE 1
Morning light is breaking through
Every shadow bows to You
All the earth wakes up to sing
Glory to the risen King

CHORUS
Rise, my soul, and sing
You are everything
Morning light, You make all things new
I will rise with You

VERSE 2
When the night was long and cold
You were near, You held my soul
Now the sun is on my face
I am standing in Your grace

BRIDGE
Darkness runs, the dawn has come
Death has lost, the King has won
